manual_interventions.summary: Actual-client studies required operator/user continuations and repairs; for example scientist06 v28 completed five calls but needed continuation and delivered a numerically incorrect narrative. The later repaired runs do not erase that journey. This is a bounded sourced example, not an exhaustive intervention count.

client_report_findings.summary: Scientist08 on v36: four ASR calls succeeded, but downstream report fact F0027 changed literal transcript 'dire light' into 'Dioralyte'. Extraction and review both set medication_or_dose=false and source_anchors=[], so the medication provenance gate was bypassed. This is a clinical source-grounding/report failure, not an ASR service failure. Original report and review remain retained; no clinical-readiness claim.

isolated_evidence.summary: DiffDock candidate 9766b4fb: 48 isolated calls across two H100 processes produced 192 poses. Matched-order cross-process coordinates/confidences are exact; within-process repeats satisfy frozen tolerances but are not all byte-identical. Only 6/12 distinct complex-seed top-ranked poses are within 2 angstrom, and the approximately 705.87 angstrom rank4 outlier remains. These are not public admissions or additional campaign operation IDs. Other isolated model studies are not inventoried by this entry.
